propertyEvents.result: Read every rental under ASC 842: a lease, and if so, short-term or not
propertyEvents.locator: Rental Register!A8:J12, Account 5400!A8:B10 and Westgate June!A8:B9; every rental, what account 5400 holds, and the June invoice

propertyEvents.result: Account 5400, $1,524,450.00, is the rental register’s $1,096,287.50 plus fuel and repairs. 4 rentals are tickets of under a month or run month to month or for no more than 12 months: short-term, rightly expensed. One is not: agreement WER-RA-3318 with Westgate Equipment Rentals rents one identified crane (serial named, no substitution) for 36 months, non-cancellable, used as HGC directs. It is a lease, expensed as a rental at $215,000.00 this year (LEASE-02).
propertyEvents.locator: Rental Register!A8:J12, Account 5400!A8:B10 and Westgate June!A8:B9; every rental, what account 5400 holds, and the June invoice

propertyEvents.result: Classify the crane lease and measure it
propertyEvents.locator: PDF page 1; the Westgate crane rental agreement’s term, rent, equipment and conditions

propertyEvents.result: No purchase option and no transfer; 36 months is a small part of a crawler crane’s life, and the payments’ present value at 7.10%, $699,392.72, is 51.8% of the crane’s $1,350,000.00 value: an operating lease. At June 30, 2026, after 10 payments, the lease liability and the right-of-use asset are $519,770.65. The rent is level, so the year’s expense is right; the balance sheet is missing both (LEASE-02).
propertyEvents.locator: PDF page 1; the Westgate crane rental agreement’s term, rent, equipment and conditions

propertyEvents.result: Measure the office lease and compare the controller’s schedule
propertyEvents.source: 07 Leases/Harbor Ridge office lease first amendment.pdf
propertyEvents.locator: PDF page 1; the office lease amendment’s new term and its rent schedule

propertyEvents.result: The office lease’s new term, January 1, 2026 to December 31, 2030, is an operating lease that is not recognized. Its rent rises 3% each January, $32,000.00 to $36,016.28 a month. At June 30, 2026 the lease liability is $1,580,613.31 and the right-of-use asset $1,568,742.50. The controller’s schedule used $32,000.00 for all 54 months left and disclosed $1,484,173.90, $96,439.41 short. Straight-line, January to June cost $203,870.81, not the $192,000.00 paid: rent is understated by $11,870.81 (LEASE-01).
propertyEvents.source: 07 Leases/Harbor Ridge office lease first amendment.pdf
propertyEvents.locator: PDF page 1; the office lease amendment’s new term and its rent schedule

propertyEvents.result: One rental is a lease, $519,771 · the office lease $1,580,613, disclosed $96,439 short · rent understated $11,871
Ready for the CPA
Set what was found against materiality
propertyEvents.locator: Register!A8:Q33, Additions!A8:G15 and Other Entries!A8:D9; every asset’s cost and accumulated depreciation, the additions and the other entries

propertyEvents.result: In income the known misstatements nearly offset: the $69,387.68 unrecorded gain against $40,808.04 of capitalized repair, $23,343.96 of depreciation and $11,870.81 of rent, a net ($6,635.13). The balance sheet is another matter: $2,100,383.96 of lease liabilities is missing, 618% of materiality, and the sold crane overstates cost by $553,061.60. The FY2026 covenant procedures read the lease note’s $1,484,173.90 (their DEF-01); this audit finds $2,100,383.96. The CPA weighs these with the other FY2026 areas. The machine stops here.
propertyEvents.locator: Register!A8:Q33, Additions!A8:G15 and Other Entries!A8:D9; every asset’s cost and accumulated depreciation, the additions and the other entries

log.text: No purchase option and no transfer; 36 months is a small part of a crawler crane’s life, and the payments’ present value at 7.10%, $699,392.72, is 51.8% of the crane’s $1,350,000.00 value: an operating lease.
